findings.title: MHFE New wallet shows and encrypts a phrase drawn for wishes the person withdrew during the draw
findings.releaseBlockingReason: A new wallet phrase that contradicts the person's last choice is published and encrypted (the class of AUD-023-SEC002).
findings.affected: apps/key-derivation/src/ui/recovery-mhfe-new-wallet.ts:189-202 (#generate reads the wishes once, then #showPhrase and #encrypt without checking that the wishes, the check answer or the passphrase answers are still current); :88 and :132 (the word radios and the wish fields only refresh the outlook; nothing cancels the running draw). Builds with the mhfe feature, both editions.
findings.reproduction: Harness docs/audits/AUD-026-harnesses/security-mhfe-new-stale-wishes.mjs on the built Deriver (Chromium, file://): MHFE, New wallet, choose the word abandon at position 1, passphrase TREZOR twice, wallet check, own password; the MHFE workers get the regression suite's public counter source 76562 and a 6-second pause; during the draw select 'Every word at random' (and edit the password, only to avoid a 2 GiB Argon2 run). Records security-mhfe-new-stale-wishes and coordinator-confirm-sec-stale-wishes (exit 1, the defect reproduced).
findings.expected: An edit of the wishes stops the draw or drops its result, as Generate & Derive does since AUD-024-API002 ('a phrase made for the earlier wishes must not be published').
findings.observed: After the switch to 'Every word at random' the tab shows 'New seed phrase, 24 words' whose first word is abandon, the withdrawn chosen word. Without the password edit, lines 201-202 would encrypt that phrase at once (static trace).
findings.impact: The person's last explicit answer for a new wallet is overridden: the phrase keeps a chosen word (about 11 fewer random bits, and recognisable, which the page's own warning tells the person to avoid for a wallet behind a decoy) and is sealed into a container. It needs a change of the answer while a checked draw runs. No key disclosure or network request.
findings.recommendedFix: Give the tab one draw revision: a change of the word radios, the wish fields, the check radios or the passphrase fields cancels the running draw (engine.cancelDraw through the run), and #generate compares the wishes, the check answer and the passphrase before showing or encrypting; drop the result otherwise. Reuse the Generate & Derive invalidation rule instead of a second copy.
findings.requiredVerification: Unit test with a fake engine (each kind of edit during a pending draw: nothing shown, nothing encrypted); a browser case beside mhfe-chosen-word in both editions and both browsers, with the delayed-worker fixture that avoids Argon2.

findings.title: The Scanner's export tripwire does not detect the Base64, percent-encoded and upper-case hexadecimal forms its SECURITY.md promises
findings.affected: apps/discovery-scanner/SECURITY.md:22; apps/discovery-scanner/src/validated-exports.ts:25 (the whole serialized file is one inspected value); packages/secret-boundary/src/secret-guard.ts:23-48 (Base64 and percent views only when the entire value is one token), :83-99 (byte secrets registered as lower-case hex only, compared case-sensitively). Seed-capable Scanner builds, both editions.
findings.reproduction: pnpm exec vitest run --config docs/audits/AUD-026-harnesses/security-vitest.config.mjs docs/audits/AUD-026-harnesses/security-guards.audit.test.ts (record security-guards, exit 1: 30 pass, 3 claim tests fail): the real ScanSecrets registers abandon … about, TREZOR and its seed; ValidatedRecoveryExports.stage receives a CSV whose one cell carries the secret.
findings.expected: SECURITY.md:22: staging is refused for a registered raw, hexadecimal, Base64, percent-encoded or separator-obfuscated representation within one inspected value.
findings.observed: Raw and hyphen-joined phrases are refused, but not the Base64 of the phrase in one cell, the percent-encoded phrase when another cell holds '100%', or the Base64 of the seed; on the RPC path an upper-case hex or Base64 seed passes while lower-case hex is blocked.
findings.impact: Defense in depth only: no product export or request carries such values, so no leak is shown. A documented safety property does not hold, and byte secrets are covered in one spelling only.
findings.recommendedFix: Either state exactly what is matched, or inspect exports per cell or token and add Base64/Base64url (padded and unpadded) and upper-case hex views of registered bytes, comparing hex case-insensitively; keep the public-report false-positive test.
findings.requiredVerification: The three claim tests of security-guards.audit.test.ts as repository tests, plus a public-report false-positive test.

findings.title: The PSBT Inspector's last timelock template presents a failing CLTV operand or a disabled CSV operand as a lock value
findings.affected: apps/psbt-inspector/src/script.ts:277-287 (the last template of infer(), '<operand> CLTV|CSV DROP|VERIFY <multisig>', reads the operand directly instead of through lockAt at :209-230). PSBT Inspector, both editions.
findings.reproduction: decodeScript(hex, 'bitcoin', 'mainnet', 'spending').inferredPolicy with the public generator key: 0181 b1 75 51 21<key> 51 ae (operand -1, CLTV) and 050000008000 b2 75 51 21<key> 51 ae (operand 2^31, CSV with the disable flag). Harness functional-script.test.ts, record functional-script; the coordinator confirmed the code path by reading.
findings.expected: BIP65 fails the script for a negative operand (no spend path); BIP112 makes CSV a no-op when bit 31 is set (no delay). lockAt already describes both so for the OR templates and names absolute versus relative.
findings.observed: '1-of-1 multisig after lock value -1' and '1-of-1 multisig after lock value 2147483648': both read as a time-locked multisig, without the kind or unit of the lock.
findings.impact: An inspector user can read an unspendable script (negative CLTV) or an undelayed one (disabled CSV) as a valid timelocked multisig. The operation list and asm stay visible; no signing involved. AUD-024-FUN002's fix covered only the OR templates.
findings.recommendedFix: Use lockAt (and RelativeSequence) for this template too: one lock-description path for every template.
findings.requiredVerification: decodeScript regressions for a negative CLTV, a disabled CSV, a 5-byte CLTV operand and block and time CSV operands in this template.

findings.title: Platform address proof batches treat a requested address missing from the answer as unused
findings.affected: apps/discovery-scanner/src/coins/dash/platform-scanner.ts:37-73 (validatePlatformAddressBatch never compares the returned keys with the requested ones) and its uses at :151-153, apps/discovery-scanner/src/coins/dash/watch-only.ts:235-245 and :388-393. Discovery Scanner, both editions.
findings.reproduction: scanDashPlatformAddresses with a synthetic client whose batch omits the funded storage key (or returns no entries). Harness functional-discovery.test.ts, record functional-discovery.
findings.expected: CHECK-FUN-007: responses are validated against the requested resources and missing values never become zero; the Core, Bitcoin and Ethereum batch validators already refuse a batch that drops an address.
findings.observed: The section is 'complete' with no finding and a 0 DASH balance and no warning; extra keys are ignored.
findings.impact: Defense in depth: it needs a misbehaving SDK or network side, which could also answer null. The repository fixture platform-chains.test.ts:62-70 itself omits unused entries, so the fix must change it; the live SDK's key set was not observed (no network).
findings.recommendedFix: Require exactly the requested storage keys (each present, null for proved absence) and refuse duplicates and extras in validatePlatformAddressBatch for all three callers; update the fixture.
findings.requiredVerification: Omitted, extra and duplicate key cases for seed, xpub and exact-key scans; one live smoke run that confirms the SDK returns every requested key.

findings.title: A discovery post-use gap cut short by a profile's maximum is not reported

findings.title: The PSBT Inspector's asm view prints an empty token for a zero-length push
findings.affected: apps/psbt-inspector/src/script.ts:117-120 and apps/psbt-inspector/src/script-number.ts:11-16 (its comment says no opcode reads an empty push as a number; an empty push is the script number 0).
findings.reproduction: decodeScript('4c0051', …).asm gives ' OP_1' with a leading empty token. Record functional-script.
findings.expected: Bitcoin Core's ScriptToAsmStr prints pushes of up to four bytes as their script number, here 0.
findings.observed: An empty token instead of 0.
findings.impact: Cosmetic misreading of non-minimal scripts; values and the operation list are unaffected.
findings.recommendedFix: Return 0 for an empty push in scriptNumberOf or print 0 in pushedValueAsm; correct the comment.
findings.requiredVerification: asm of 4c00, 4d0000, 00 and a 4-byte push.

findings.title: A derivation setting changed during a Generate & Derive draw lets the draw run to its end and drops the phrase silently under a frozen status
findings.affected: apps/key-derivation/src/ui/controller.ts:966-975 (refresh bumps derivationRevision but neither cancels the checked mode or the chosen-word search nor clears the status), :1042, :1050, :1052 (later status lines and the finished phrase dropped). Deriver, both editions.
findings.reproduction: node docs/audits/AUD-026-harnesses/integration-ui-probes.mjs draw chromium (record integration-ui-draw-chromium): MHFE wallet check, passphrase and confirmation TREZOR, Generate 24 words, then change the result count during the draw.
findings.expected: The comment at controller.ts:1049 names what may win over a running generation (another Generate, Clear all or a typed phrase); otherwise the phrase is shown, or the draw stops at once and the page says so.
findings.observed: The draw ran 34.3 s more with Cancel visible, the status stayed 'Drawing a phrase that passes the check · 1,024 tried · 2 s elapsed', and no phrase and no error appeared.
findings.impact: A lost generation of tens of seconds and a stale progress line; no secret exposure. Related to AUD-024-API002 with another trigger.
findings.recommendedFix: Bind a generation to a phrase revision of its own, separate from the derivation revision, or cancel the draw and replace the status in refresh.
findings.requiredVerification: The draw probe (phrase shown or immediate stop with a status) in both browsers; a controller unit test with a fake checked mode.

findings.title: Watch-only Discovery Scanner builds fail because ScanSecrets pulls the BIP39 seed code into every watch-only adapter
findings.releaseBlockingReason: The canonical build (smoke matrix) and the release browser job (selective suite) fail.
findings.affected: apps/discovery-scanner/src/scan-secrets.ts:4 (imports assertValidMnemonic and mnemonicToSeed from @ckd/core/bip39.js for seed() and forSeed()); the watch-only adapters that construct it (coins/bitcoin/watch-only.ts, coins/ethereum/watch-only.ts, coins/dash/watch-only.ts); the refusing gate tooling/discovery-composition.mjs:474-481. scan-secrets.ts is new in the AUD-024 remediation (uncommitted). Every Discovery build with watch-only-discovery and without seed-discovery, in both editions; the default editions are not affected.
findings.reproduction: node apps/discovery-scanner/scripts/build-discovery-scanner-html.mjs --profile multi-chain --coins bitcoin --features watch-only-discovery --output <scratch>/x.html fails with 'Watch-only Discovery contains seed/Vault modules: packages/crypto-core/src/bip39.ts'. Import chain (record build-discovery-watch-only-trace): selected registry → coins/bitcoin/watch-adapter.ts → coins/bitcoin/watch-only.ts → scan-secrets.ts → packages/crypto-core/src/bip39.ts. Records build-matrix-smoke (stops at job 10 of 70), build-selective-sample (6 of 70 smoke jobs and 2 extras fail) and coordinator-browser-selective (fails while building its variants).
findings.expected: docs/BUILD_MODULES.md:8 and :64: a watch-only-only build physically excludes mnemonic, seed-worker and secret-vault modules; the documented example at :105-106 builds.
findings.observed: No watch-only-only Discovery build can be produced in either edition.
findings.impact: A supported, documented composition is unavailable and the release path is blocked: Dockerfile.reproducible:83 runs pnpm build:matrix:smoke, and the browser job of ci.yml and release.yml runs pnpm test:browser:selective, which builds all variants before any browser starts. No security impact: the gate refused the graph, so no watch-only page with seed code was produced. selective-composition.test.mjs checks the gate only on hand-written input lists.

findings.title: The canonical WASM manifest was rewritten outside the canonical container and the local gate cannot tell
findings.affected: tooling/wasm-canonical-manifest.json (all four sourceSha256 values and the SSKR WASM hash d6388a06… changed on 2026-10-08); tooling/verify-wasm-integrity.mjs:82-85 (--write runs on any host); README.md:203.
findings.reproduction: Records build-wasm-integrity (gate passes) and build-docker-images (the newest canonical WASM image is from 2026-10-02, before the SSKR lib.rs change and the build-script refactor); the SSKR WASM equals MnemoCode's own container output, which its AUD-013 records as not canonically rebuilt.
findings.expected: Committed generated WASM is canonical: regenerated only by the canonical Docker build, and README.md:203 says verification rejects host-generated bytes.
findings.observed: The manifest claims the canonical generator without a canonical run, and verify-wasm-integrity --write accepts a host rewrite.
findings.impact: Whether the bytes differ from a canonical build is unknown (the Docker rebuild was not run, by the owner's rule). The release build compares every committed generated file, so a mismatch fails at release; until then pnpm verify reports a canonical pass that is not established.
findings.recommendedFix: Run the canonical WASM build before the release and keep its manifest; refuse --write outside the canonical container; word README.md:203 as what the local gate proves.
findings.requiredVerification: Canonical --wasm build and its Docker comparison step; a host --write is refused.
